description: Renovate is intentionally disabled: Pleasantest is no longer actively maintained.

The previous config set prConcurrentLimit to 3 and three Renovate PRs have sat open since 2024, so Renovate had been unable to open anything new since March 2025 - it was already inert, just noisily so.
Updating dependencies here would not reach the package's users in any case, since that requires a release and the last publish was v5.0.0 in July 2024.
Dependabot still reports security advisories, which is the coverage that matters for an unmaintained public package.
To pick maintenance back up, delete this file and add: { "extends": ["local>cloudfour/renovate-config:library"] }
